info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Sale By Param1-spec
info.description: The Sales Product Matching API allows users to retrieve specific sales information based on a given parameter. By utilizing the parameterized endpoint, developers can fetch detailed sale records that correspond with specific product identifiers. This API is essential for retailers and financial services looking to analyze sales data, optimize inventory, or improve customer service. Typical consumers include data analysts, business intelligence tools, and e-commerce platforms seeking real-time sales insights.

get.summary: Retrieve product matching details for sales.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the product matching information for the specified product ID in the sales context. It is useful for obtaining detailed matching data for analysis and reporting purposes.

requestBody.description: Request body for the product matching operation for the specified product code (PROD-700045). This body contains the necessary parameters to perform the product matching and retrieve relevant information about the product.

200.description: The request was successful, and the product data is returned.

GetSaleByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the product matching operation in the sales system. It is expected to be a JSON string.
